The '''Phindar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Demetras sector/Legends|Demetras sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phindar/Legends|Phindar]], and the spaceport [[Phindar Station]]. Judging by [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] comments, the [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located close to [[Gala]].
